name: Amounts alleged in whistleblower claims
definition: Money (underreported income, unpaid tax or similar) that whistleblowers allege in the claims a programme received in a period, as tallied by the source. Unverified allegations only: excludes amounts assessed (taxes_assessed_attributable) or collected (collections_attributable). Breakdown item= says what was alleged.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa20. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa20 (TIGTA 2009 audit, Figure 2: alleged underreported income in 7623(b) claims, CY2007-CY2008).

name: Other money identified thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Money other than tax (damage to the state, civil claims filed) that investigations based on whistleblower information identified or claimed, whether or not recovered or granted. Excludes tax identified (taxes_assessed_attributable), sanctions ordered (sanctions_ordered) and money collected (collections_attributable). Breakdown item= says which.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-ltu1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-ltu1 (Lithuanian Prosecutor's Office reports). Companion to taxes_assessed_attributable and collections_attributable.

name: Appeals of award determinations
definition: Challenges of award determinations (denials or amounts) filed in a period or to date: appeals to a court or appeal body, or internal requests for reconsideration of a preliminary determination (item=reconsideration_requests). Unit says appeals or requests. Excludes the decisions themselves.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (GAO-11-683: more than 20 Tax Court appeals of IRS award denials by 2011).

name: Award claims received
definition: Applications for a whistleblower award (e.g. SEC/CFTC/NHTSA Form WB-APP, Korean reward applications, Lithuanian and Slovak reward requests) received in a period, as the source counts them; stage=admitted for applications formally admitted (Hungary). Unit says claims or applications; breakdown outcome= splits received applications by what became of them. Excludes tips (tips_received): where a programme has no separate award application (IRS Form 211 claims), its claims are tips.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs award_applications_admitted, award_applications_received. proposed by research:sec-cftc. Distinct from tips_received (tips) and claims_closed (decided claims). Proposed by sec-cftc pass.

name: Average reward rate
definition: Rewards paid as a percentage of the money recovered or collected on which they were based (reward-eligible amount), over a period, as printed by the source; value_high for a printed range. Excludes the size of single awards (award_size).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1.

name: Award size
definition: Size of a single award as printed by the source: the average award per approved application, rewarded case or award (default, or stat=average), or the highest or lowest single award in a period (stat=highest, stat=lowest). Excludes totals paid (awards_paid_amount) and awards as a share of recoveries (award_rate_average).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11); replaces award_average (renamed).

name: Awards accrued (determined, not yet paid)
definition: Whistleblower awards a programme has recognised but not yet paid at a date or in a period: liabilities for awards, probable or contingent award claims accrued, awards finalised in accounts payable, obligated but not disbursed, preliminarily determined, or the estimated range of possible future payments (status estimate). Breakdown item= says which. Excludes awards paid (awards_paid_amount).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC fund table line 'contingent claims to Fund resources accrued'; needed so the fund table adds up).

name: Awards paid (amount)
definition: Money paid or awarded to whistleblowers as rewards in a period or to date, including False Claims Act relator shares; notes say where the source counts awards made rather than paid. Includes, as items for reconciliation, amounts before sequestration and the amount withheld by sequestration (item=before_sequestration, item=sequestration_reduction). Excludes awards accrued but unpaid (awards_accrued), relief payments for damages (relief_paid) and the size of single awards (award_size).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs relator_share_awards.

name: Awards paid (number)
definition: Number of awards paid or made in a period or to date (notes say whether paid or determined). The unit says what is counted when the source counts something else per award: orders granting awards, covered or related actions, agreements or matters with awards, claims tied to paid awards. Excludes distinct persons (individuals_awarded) and percentages (awards_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11).

name: Awards reduced for a negative factor
definition: Awards whose percentage a programme reduced in a period because of a negative factor (unreasonable reporting delay, culpability, interference with internal reporting); breakdown item= gives the reason, unit says whether awards, whistleblowers (persons) or matters.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports FY2021-FY2025).

name: Awards share
definition: Percentage of a programme's awards (measure=count), award money (measure=amount), award recipients (measure=recipients) or respondents in award cases (measure=respondents), in a period or to date, that have one feature (legal basis, reduced for delay, anonymous tip, reported internally first, foreign, individuals); breakdown item= or subsection= names the feature. Printed by the source, never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11); created by the indicator review for percentages that were filed in count or money indicators.

name: Cases handled by a whistleblower authority
definition: Cases, files or matters a whistleblower protection authority dealt with in a period, as the source counts them; breakdown scope= (within or outside its competence), type=, retaliation= or unit= says which. Excludes percentages (tips_share, stage=handled).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (Slovak Whistleblower Protection Office reports).

name: Claimants barred for frivolous claims
definition: Individuals a programme permanently barred from applying for awards in a period (e.g. SEC bar after frivolous award claims).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports: 'barred five claimants ... in FY 2025').

name: Claims closed
definition: Tips, reports, claims or award applications a programme closed or decided in a period, for any reason (award, denial, rejection, transfer, no action), as the source counts them. Unit says reports, claims, applications or orders; breakdown reason= or outcome= gives the ground (reason=denied for final denials of award claims), item= the disposal. Excludes percentages (tips_share, stage=closed).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs award_claims_denied.

name: Open claims (inventory)
definition: Tips, claims, submissions or award applications still open (not closed) at a date, as the source counts them (unit says claims, submissions, taxpayers, persons, reports or applications); breakdown item=, step= or stage= for where they sit. Excludes percentages (tips_share, stage=open) and how long they have been there (claims_time_in_status).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:irs. Needed for the IRS backlog: annual reports print open-inventory tables by status. Unit says what is counted.

name: Claims processed through a step
definition: Claims (or examination modules tied to claims) that a programme, or a unit working for it, completed or moved through a named processing step in a period, e.g. classified for tax potential or moved to suspense in a backlog cleanup; breakdown item= names the step.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa20. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa20 (TIGTA 2016 audit: SB/SE classified 8,053 / 10,225 / 14,493 claims in FY2013-FY2015; December 2015 cleanup of 2,982 claims).

name: Claims referred for examination
definition: Tips, reports or claims that the programme sent to field examination, investigation or another competent body in a period (including criminal complaints or forwarded cases), as the source counts them; breakdown outcome= splits referred reports by what the investigation found (substantiated, unsubstantiated, under investigation, other action), agency= by where they went. Excludes percentages (tips_share) and notices telling whistleblowers about a referral (notices_to_whistleblowers).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:irs. IRS annual reports from FY2018 print receipts selected for referral to field examination (Table 2B), a measure of how many tips are actually acted on.

name: Days open claims have spent in their current status
definition: For claims still open at a date, the average, longest or shortest time they have spent in their current processing status (breakdown item= or step= gives the status, stat= the measure), in the unit printed. Not the time from claim to award (processing_time).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS annual reports FY2011-FY2013, tables of days in current status for open 7623(b) claims).

name: Money collected thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Money the government collected or recovered (taxes, penalties, sanctions, settlements and judgments, reclaimed public funds) in cases brought or prompted by a whistleblower, in a period or to date; for the False Claims Act, settlements and judgments in qui tam cases (breakdown intervention=, agency=). Excludes amounts merely assessed, ordered or alleged, recoveries in cases not started by a whistleblower (recoveries_non_whistleblower_cases), and percentages (recoveries_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs recoveries_whistleblower_cases.

name: Compliance inspections
definition: Inspections by a whistleblower authority of employers' compliance with whistleblower law (internal reporting systems, treatment of whistleblowers) in a period; breakdown status= or outcome=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Document requests reviewed to protect whistleblower identity
definition: Requests to produce or share enforcement documents that a whistleblower office reviewed in a period to protect whistleblower confidentiality; breakdown requester= (enforcement_litigation, other_agencies) and scope= (all, involving_whistleblowers, identifying_information).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports from FY2017).

name: Employer requests to act against a protected whistleblower
definition: Employer requests for a whistleblower authority's consent to a labour-law act (dismissal, other measure) against a protected whistleblower, received or decided in a period; breakdown act=, status= or outcome=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Fines imposed for breaching whistleblower law
definition: Amount of fines or civil penalties imposed in a period by an authority on employers, firms or persons for breaching whistleblower-protection rules (identity protection, retaliation, impeding reporting such as SEC Rule 21F-17, internal reporting duties); breakdown item= names the target or the rule. Money only: the number of fines is in protection_enforcement_actions.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Cases handled by the agency enforcing a reward law
definition: Cases or matters opened, closed or pending in a period at the agency or division that enforces a whistleblower reward law, counting all its cases, whistleblower-initiated or not; breakdown item= opened, closed, pending (or another status the source names).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa21. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa21 (Texas joint interagency coordination reports FY2015-FY2025: Civil Medicaid Fraud / Healthcare Program Enforcement Division cases opened, closed and pending). cases_handled is defined for whistleblower protection authorities, so not used.

name: Share of enforcement matters involving whistleblowers
definition: Percentage of an agency's enforcement matters or open investigations that involve or originate with whistleblowers, as the source states it; breakdown item= for the base.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC FY2024 report: 'About 42% of the CFTC's enforcement matters involve whistleblowers').

name: People or calls contacting the authority
definition: Contacts with a whistleblower authority or programme that are not tips: counselling and guidance requests, helpline calls, emails, chat registrations, in a period (unit says consultations, calls, emails or persons; breakdown channel=; stat= for a monthly average or extreme). Excludes tips and reports (tips_received) and percentages (tips_share, stage=enquiry).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Tax assessed per examination hour in whistleblower cases
definition: Tax assessed (net of refunds) per hour worked on closed examinations associated with whistleblower claims, in a period, as computed by the source; breakdown function= gives the examination programme.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa20. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa20 (TIGTA 2023 audit, Figure 11).

name: No-change rate of whistleblower examinations
definition: Percentage of closed examinations (or examination modules) associated with whistleblower claims that closed with no additional tax assessed, in a period; breakdown function= gives the examination programme.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa20. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa20 (TIGTA 2023 audit, Figure 12).

name: Forecast Exchequer yield of a reward measure
definition: Official forecast of the extra net tax revenue a reward measure is expected to bring in a future year (e.g. a costing certified by a fiscal council). Always status projection. Excludes money actually collected (collections_attributable).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:uk-europe. Proposed for the UK Budget 2025 costing of the Strengthened Reward Scheme.

name: Non-qui tam fraud matters opened
definition: New False Claims Act matters opened by the government itself (referrals and investigations not started by a whistleblower suit) in a period, as counted by the DOJ Civil Division ('New matters - non qui tam'); breakdown agency=. Context for qui tam suits, which are counted in tips_received.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:false-claims-act. Context for qui_tam_suits_filed: shows what share of new FCA matters come from whistleblowers.

name: Balance of the reward fund
definition: Balance of a dedicated fund or account that pays awards (e.g. SEC Investor Protection Fund, CFTC Customer Protection Fund) at a date; breakdown item= when the source gives a specific balance line (total assets, net position, separate account), agency= for multi-agency programmes.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11).

name: Deposits into the reward fund
definition: Money deposited into or credited to a dedicated reward fund in a period (collected sanctions, released sequestration); breakdown item= for a named deposit.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (CFTC FY2011 report, statutory report item).

name: Investment earnings of the reward fund
definition: Earnings on investments of a dedicated reward fund in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (CFTC FY2011 report, statutory report item).

name: Other payments from the reward fund
definition: Money paid, incurred, transferred or sequestered from a dedicated reward fund in a period for anything other than awards (customer education, administrative expenses, Inspector General, sequestration, transfers); breakdown item= says which and whether paid or unpaid. Excludes awards (awards_paid_amount).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC Customer Protection Fund statutory table; needed so the fund table can be checked).

name: Individuals awarded
definition: Number of distinct persons who received an award (money, or a state honour where item=state_honours) in a period or to date; breakdown item= for a subgroup. Excludes the number of awards (awards_paid_count) and percentages (awards_share, measure=recipients).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11).

name: Informant reward contracts signed
definition: Reward contracts an agency has signed with informants (cumulative or in a period), where a reward requires a contract (Canada CRA OTIP).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:international. Canada CRA OTIP, where a reward requires a signed contract.

name: Proceedings opened on whistleblower information
definition: Investigations or proceedings an authority opened (or prepared to open) in a period on information from whistleblowers or informants; breakdown item= says which channel or type.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-hun1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-hun1 (GVH 2016 report: 1 proceeding from the informant reward, 2 from Kartell Chat).

name: Refusals to open proceedings on whistleblower information
definition: Decisions in a period not to open an investigation or proceeding on information from whistleblowers; breakdown item= type of investigation.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-ltu1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-ltu1 (Lithuanian Prosecutor's Office: refusals to open a pre-trial investigation).

name: Share of eligible awards given the maximum-award presumption
definition: Percentage of eligible award determinations in which an agency applied its presumption of the statutory maximum award, in a period, as printed by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC FY2024 report: presumption applied about 90% of the time where the maximum award would be $5 million or less).

name: Notices of Covered Action posted
definition: Notices of Covered Action a programme posts in a period or to date: enforcement actions whose sanctions pass the award threshold, opening a window for award claims (SEC, CFTC, NHTSA).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports print NCAs posted each year).

name: Status notices sent to whistleblowers
definition: Notices or letters a programme sent to whistleblowers about their claim in a period (e.g. IRS Taxpayer First Act notices: referral for audit, payment of tax, status and stage letters; late payment notifications), breakdown item= says which, delay= for lateness; also claims with whistleblower requests for a status letter (item=status_and_stage_requests_..., unit claims). Excludes the share sent on time (timeliness_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS FY2021-FY2024 reports, Taxpayer First Act disclosure tables). The referral notices already in the data are filed under claims_referred_to_exam item=tfa_referral_notices; the main session may move them here.

name: Preliminary determinations on award claims
definition: Preliminary decisions a programme issued on award claims in a period, before the final order, as the source counts them (unit determinations, claims or letters); breakdown item= says which: award_recommended, denial_recommended, preliminary_summary_dispositions, preliminary_award_recommendation_letters (IRS PARLs) or all. Excludes final orders (claims_closed).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs preliminary_award_letters. proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports FY2020-FY2025: Preliminary Determinations recommending awards or denials, Preliminary Summary Dispositions). Overlaps preliminary_award_letters (IRS letters); the SEC award recommendations are filed here instead.

name: Time to decide a claim
definition: Time a programme takes to handle claims, in the unit printed (days, months or years; value_high for a range): from receipt to award decision, payment or closure, or for one stage (item= or step= names the stage, reason= the closure reason); stat= for average (default), typical, shortest, longest or maximum. Statements of typical duration in guidance are status as given. Excludes the time open claims have spent in their current status (claims_time_in_status) and the share processed within a target (timeliness_share). Never converted.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11).

name: Cost of running a whistleblower programme
definition: Money spent or expected to be spent on administering a whistleblower programme (staff, IT, outreach) in a period, excluding the awards themselves; status budget or projection for plans and estimates.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (FinCEN NPRM 2026: $1.8 million first year, $1.6 million a year after; CBO estimates).

name: Staff of a whistleblower office
definition: People working in a whistleblower or award office at a date, or its authorised or needed staffing level, as the source counts them (unit persons or FTE); breakdown item= says which (unit, role, start/end of year).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (IRS annual reports FY2008-FY2009 print Whistleblower Office staffing; GAO reports do too).

name: Protected whistleblower statuses granted
definition: Whistleblowers (or statuses) granted formal protected status in a period (e.g. Slovak 'status chráneného oznamovateľa'); breakdown granted_by= or assisted_by=. Excludes percentages (protection_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Enforcement actions to protect whistleblowers
definition: Enforcement actions or sanctions (actions, proceedings, fines) an authority brought or imposed in a period or to date for breaching whistleblower protections: impeding reporting (e.g. SEC Rule 21F-17), retaliation, breaching a whistleblower's identity protection, failing internal-reporting duties; breakdown item= gives the breach. Unit says actions or fines. The amounts are in employer_fines_imposed.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports FY2020-FY2024). The penalties themselves go in employer_fines_imposed.

name: Requests for protective measures
definition: Requests by whistleblowers (or witnesses) for a protective measure (guarantee of position, physical protection, confidentiality, suspension of an employer's act, protected status) received or handled in a period; breakdown measure= and outcome=. Unit requests (or an annual average, unit 'requests per year'). Excludes acceptance rates (protection_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Protection share
definition: Percentage of whistleblower protection requests (default) or protected statuses granted (stage=status_granted) that have one outcome or feature: acceptance rate (outcome=acceptance_rate), granting body (granted_by=). Printed by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11); created by the indicator review for percentages that were filed in count or money indicators.

name: Whistleblowers given psychosocial or career support
definition: Whistleblowers given support by an authority in a period: psychological or career support, state-guaranteed legal aid (measure=secondary_legal_aid), or relief payments for costs and damages (measure=relief_payment, unit cases); unit=sessions for sessions held. The money paid as relief is in relief_paid.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Protective measures taken
definition: Protective measures an authority took for whistleblowers in a period on its own initiative (e.g. preventive measures before any retaliation), as the source counts them; breakdown item=. Excludes measures requested by whistleblowers (protection_requests).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (ACRC 2011 report).

name: Public awareness of the whistleblower system
definition: Percentage of the public that knows of a whistleblower protection or reward system, from a survey, as printed by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (ACRC survey figures 2011-2020).

name: Recoveries in cases not brought by whistleblowers
definition: Money recovered (settlements and judgments) under a whistleblower reward law in cases that did not start with a whistleblower (qui tam) suit, in a period; breakdown agency=. Context for collections_attributable. Series break at FY2020 (U.S. Attorneys' Offices matters added).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:false-claims-act. DOJ FCA table column "Settlements and judgments - non qui tam". Has a series break at FY2020 (U.S. Attorneys' Office matters added).

name: Share of recoveries by category
definition: Percentage of a money total (all recoveries under a law, or proceeds collected in whistleblower cases) in a period that falls in a category (industry, agency, origin such as category=qui_tam, legal basis, time slice), as printed by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa3. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa3 (DOJ FY2006 FCA release: 72% health care, 20% defence, 8% other).

name: State bonus share of Medicaid fraud recoveries
definition: Money from Medicaid false-claims recoveries that a US state keeps instead of returning it to the federal government because its own false claims act qualifies under section 1909 of the Social Security Act, in a period.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa8. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa8 (New York MFCU annual letters 2018-2020).

name: Total recoveries
definition: All money recovered by the government under a whistleblower reward law in a period (settlements and judgments), whistleblower cases or not; breakdown agency=, category=, recipient=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11).

name: Relief money paid to whistleblowers
definition: Money paid to whistleblowers to reimburse costs or damages caused by reporting (medical, relocation, litigation, lost wages); not a reward. Money only: the number of payments is in protection_support_provided (measure=relief_payment).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (Korean 구조금).

name: Respondents sanctioned in whistleblower cases
definition: Respondents (persons, organisations) against whom enforcement action was taken in matters where whistleblower information contributed, in a period or to date, as the source counts them; breakdown item= for the action (indicted, disciplined, warned, fined). Excludes percentages (awards_share, measure=respondents).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-can1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-can1 (OSC: '19 respondents'). Companion to sanctions_ordered.

name: Money authorised for paying rewards
definition: Money a law authorises or appropriates for paying whistleblower or informant rewards in a period (always status budget).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa2. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa2 (Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Act: $450,000 authorised for FY2021).

name: Sanctions ordered in whistleblower cases
definition: Monetary sanctions (fines, disgorgement, additional charges, civil claims granted) ordered, not necessarily collected, in enforcement actions that used whistleblower information; breakdown item= for a component. Excludes money collected (collections_attributable).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11).

name: Settlements and judgments (number)
definition: Number of settlements and judgments (resolved matters) a programme obtained in a period, whistleblower cases or not; breakdown category= for a subset.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa4. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa4 (DOJ FCA releases from FY2022 print the number of settlements and judgments; companion to recoveries_total).

name: Supplemental submissions per supplemented tip
definition: Average number of supplemental submissions filed per original tip that was supplemented, as printed by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (FinCEN NPRM 2026 Table 4). Could instead be folded into a generic ratio indicator.

name: Taxes assessed thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Additional tax assessed or identified as owing in cases using whistleblowers' information, whether or not collected; breakdown item=, function=.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:international. Separate from collections_attributable (money actually collected).

name: On-time share
definition: Percentage of claims processed, or notices to whistleblowers issued, within a statutory or internal time limit in a period; breakdown item= names the step or notice (stat=timely). Printed by the source.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11); created by the indicator review for percentages that were filed in count or money indicators.

name: Countries tips came from
definition: Number of countries from which a programme received tips in a period or to date (unit countries).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-can1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-can1 (OSC: tips from 30 countries). SEC/CFTC annual reports print similar counts.

name: Whistleblower tips or submissions received
definition: Tips, reports, submissions or claims whistleblowers filed with a programme in a period, as the source counts them; unit says what is counted: tips, reports, submissions, claims (IRS Form 211 claims), taxpayers named, cases (False Claims Act qui tam suits), or persons (distinct whistleblowers filing), and 'reports per month' for a printed monthly average. Breakdown category=, country=, region= etc. Excludes award applications (award_claims_received), enquiries (enquiries_received) and percentages (tips_share).
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs qui_tam_suits_filed, whistleblowers_filing.

name: Share of tips in a category
definition: Percentage of the enquiries, tips, reports, claims or cases a programme or whistleblower authority received or dealt with that have one feature or outcome, as printed by the source. The base is tips received unless stage= says otherwise (enquiry, handled, referred, open, closed); breakdown item=, category=, country=, outcome=, reason= etc. names the feature. Printed by the source, never calculated by us.
notes: Reviewed and accepted 2026-10-10 (decision 11). Absorbs tip_share. proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS FY2010 report: about 85 percent of submissions do not meet the 7623(b) thresholds).
